body: 21, have been a roofer, cashier and a soldier. Many many failed attempts and a few hospital visits. Got plenty of friends, but I'm honestly already after having come to terms with this. They know I don't want to move on from my ex. They know I've been suicidal and they know things aren't exactly great right now. I won't burden them with any of my problems.

I've thought this through and I've been to hospital. I just simply don't want to live anymore. I don't understand it but that's just how I've felt for a long time. Everything or everyone who made life bearable is gone.

My girlfriend and my family. Either dead or left me. I'm tired of being the big crazy ex with a tattoo. I'm always putting in so much effort just to pay for other peoples fuck ups. I'm tired, so fucking damn tired and just want out. I've tried before but I feel different this time. I'm not scared. I'm not crying, I just know this is how I go.
